Backend: 20/20 tests PASS in test_iter6.py covering BUG1 password-reset request/confirm, BUG2 admin /test-email JSON shape + auth, BUG3 marketplace messages send/threads/history/mark-read/cannot-self, BUG4 km_driven formula via /vehicles/stats (per_vehicle 15000 active + 45000 archived = 60000 total) and /analytics/me total_km, CHANGE1 max_photos_per_vehicle=6, CHANGE2 forum make+model filters, CHANGE3 /vehicles/search with searchable+profile_visible privacy filtering and owner enrichment. critical_code_review_comments: /api/auth/password-reset/confirm correctly rejects regular login JWT tokens (type=user) with 400 'Invalid token' — only accepts type=password_reset tokens.
/api/admin/test-email now returns deterministic JSON {success, error, to} (200) — never 502; admin auth required (401 without token). Verified via logs: SMTP send → and SMTP OK → captured.

/api/vehicles/stats correctly applies _km_driven formula: archived uses mileage_at_sale, else mileage_current; both minus mileage_at_purchase. Returns total_km_driven + active_count + archived_count + per_vehicle array.
/api/vehicles/search privacy filter is correct: searchable!=False AND (privacy.profile_visible!=False OR privacy missing). Owner enrichment via $in lookup is index-friendly.
Forum threads make/model filter handles BOTH linked vehicle (vehicle_id→vehicles.make/model) and free-text vehicle_label via $or — good defense-in-depth.

Marketplace messages /threads aggregation pipeline is correct: groups by (listing_id, other_user) with last_message + unread count via $cond. /messages/{listing}/{other} fetches history AND marks own messages as read in single roundtrip.
VehicleForm: vf-mileage-at-sale is conditionally rendered only when status=archived (intentional). vf-mileage-at-purchase always visible.
Note: /api/profile is not the right endpoint for onboarded toggle — use PUT /api/auth/me. Documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md would help future agents.
FirstUseTooltips overlay can intercept clicks on first navigation to pages — Playwright tests should use force=True or dismiss tooltips first. Not a bug but a testing consideration.
